note: Folio offset calibrated 24 Sept 2026 from the primary ark's own IIIF manifest labels (../manifest.json), which give true manuscript foliation per canvas (e.g. canvas id 'f69' label '35r'), not just IIIF sequence position. Pattern for single-folio canvases (index 17 = '9r' onward): recto canvas index = 2*folio - 1. Folio 35 recto = canvas index 69 (label '35r'); folio 35 verso = canvas index 70 (label '35v'). Checked against three known points: folio 16r = canvas 31 (label '16r'), folio 24r = canvas 47 (label '24r'), folio 30r = canvas 59 (label '30r') -- all match Tomokiyo's cited folios exactly.
